description_sq:
Vile 4-kateshe ne Ali Dem per shitje!
Ne zonen e Ali Demit, shume prane kompleksit Mangalem, ofrojme vile 4-kateshe per shitje. Vila ka nje siperfaqe totale ndertimi prej 800 m2, cdo kat nga 200 m2, si dhe nje siperfaqe prej 525 m2 toke. Aktualsiht eshte e organizuar ne:
- Kati perdhe dhe kati 1: magazine
- Kati 2: 1 apartament 2+1 te mobiluar gati per banim, dhe 1 apartament 2+1 pa rifinituara
- Kati 3: apartament 3+1 te mobiluar
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume informacion jeni te lutur te na kontaktoni!
description_en: 4-storey villa in Ali Dem for sale! In the area of ​​Ali Demi, very close to the Mangalem complex, we offer 4-storey villas for sale. The villa has a total construction area of ​​800 m2, each floor of 200 m2, as well as an area of ​​525 m2 of land. It is currently organized in: - Ground floor and 1st floor: warehouse - 2nd floor: 1 apartment 2+1 furnished ready for living, and 1 apartment 2+1 unfinished - 3rd floor: apartment 3+1 furnished The property has regular mortgage documentation. For more information, please contact us!
